newsitem.title: CAMEROON: Air Afrique plane in near-disaster in Cameroon.
newsitem.headline: Air Afrique plane in near-disaster in Cameroon.

text.p: An Air Afrique Boeing 737 airliner crash-landed on takeoff at Douala airport in Cameroon but none of the 117 passengers and crew was seriously hurt, airport officials said on Monday.
State radio said the plane was engulfed by smoke shortly after passengers were evacuated from the crash on Sunday night, adding that it was a miracle no life was lost.
Officials said 15 passengers were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

A crew member said one of the wheels of the undercarriage exploded as the plane tried to take off for N'Djamena, Chad, via Bangui in the Central African Republic. The flight originated in Abidjan with a stop in the Togolese capital Lome.
Authorities were investigating the cause of the crash.
